description: A guardrail in block mode refuses every request, as when an organization mandates the injection check in block mode: 403 guardrail_violation and the provider is never called. A refusal like this is a finding, not a failure: the pipeline brakes with CHECKER_INJECTION from the guardrail.
source: Written by hand. The body is the guardrail_violation refusal observed on the hosted gateway on 2026-10-30 (message, code, guardrails); guardrails: Modes documents the 403.
